title: MSFS 2024 Sim Update 7: Huge FPS fixes, new EFB app & C-17 overhaul!
description:
Sim Update 7 (SU7) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is officially live (Build 1.9.18.0), and it brings massive quality-of-life improvements to the sim! If you've ever suffered from the dreaded long-haul memory leak tanking your frame rates, this update is for you

In this video, we break down the biggest highlights of SU7, including the highly anticipated avionics performance boosts, the brand new default Ground Services EFB app (and how it compares to high-end 3rd-party add-ons like the Fenix A320), the return of the National Championship Air Races, and massive flight model overhauls for the Boeing C-17 Globemaster III, H225 Helicopter, and AeroElvira Optica.

⚠️ Quick Tip: Experiencing long load times or crashes after updating? Don't forget to temporarily empty your Community folder!

Have the memory leak fixes improved your long-haul flights? Let me know in the comments!
